The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of the work:

## Repairs to existing integration defects

- **`main.py`** â rewrote document validation: exact-key checks for every object, bool-is-not-int, UTF-8/surrogate rejection, nonfinite/overflowing numbers, BOM/trailing-value rejection, combined budgets (frames+events+parts â¤ 50000, header pairs â¤ 32768, 128 pairs per block), virtual-time overflow, owner labels, and complete template compilation before replay.
- **`schema.py`** â the old eager `expand_complex_expression` mangled `{{â¦}}` templates, invented random-length strings and swallowed errors; replaced by typed pydantic payload models that carry compiled compressed payloads while keeping the documented frame names/spelling.
- **`modules/fuzz_adapter.py`** â fixed the missing `List` import crash, sleep-frame `End_Stream`, receipt recording (now an exact incremental fingerprint mixer), datagram final byte, `payload_bytes`, and case-record assembly.
- **`HTTP3_Just_Send.py`** â fixed the response-end-while-still-sending deadlock, tied response/timeout resolution, send-error termination, close semantics and receipt-retention rules.

## Completed extension modules

- **`modules/byte_program.py`** â immutable compressed sequences (`Lit/Cat/Rep/Cut`) caching length + exact fingerprint hash, logarithmic geometric hashing for repetition, windowed materialisation, range hashing; the documented byte-expression grammar (AST-validated, depth â¤ 128, byte-only final results, slice bounds against real lengths) plus definition context and per-coordinate `<<random_string>>` templates.
- **`modules/capture.py`** â piecewise attributed capture stream (small read-ahead windows, bodies skipped by length arithmetic, compressed range hashing) and the HTTP/1.1 origin reader: line/CRLF policy with 8192/8193 thresholds, block byte/field limits, Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding rules, chunked sizes/suffixes/trailers, `syntax`/`incomplete` errors at uncommitted request starts, and the 20000-request / 40000-chunk-line budgets.
- **`modules/capture_audit.py`** â origin records, per-byte provenance attribution with merged owners, and the paired evidence flags (`unattributed`, `mixed_owner`, `missing_host`, `multiple_host`, `identity`, `extra`, `unsent` and the case-level set).

Verified with ~700 hand-computed fixture checks (lifecycle, expressions, framing, flags, budgets, huge compressed captures) plus randomised robustness fuzzing; worst-case batches run in ~2 s / 136 MB under the scored rlimit+seccomp profile.
